upsert.title: Intralesional immunocytokine therapy for canine superficial tumors
upsert.center: AniCura AOI Animal Oncology and Imaging Center / ETH Zürich
upsert.status: Recruiting / participation invited on current AniCura AOI clinical-study page
upsert.funding: Confirm study-covered and owner-paid costs directly with AniCura AOI.
upsert.notes: Current AniCura AOI page states that dogs with superficial tumors are treated in a clinical study with intralesional special immunocytokines in collaboration with ETH Zürich. ETH research material describes canine F8/L19 immunocytokines and an initiated small clinical trial in dog patients with superficial tumors. Exact histologies and full eligibility require investigator prescreening.
